items.title: 7.3 Interference aur us ki aqsam (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 7.3 with Fig. 7.5 and Examples 7.1 and 7.2 (PDF 143-146).

blocks.title: Interference
blocks.text: Ek hi frequency rakhne wali aur ek hi simt mein chalne wali do waves ki superposition se jo mazhar (phenomenon) banta hai use interference kehte hain.

Sound waves ka interference dekhne ke liye tajrubati intezam Fig. 7.5(a) mein hai. Do loudspeakers S1 aur S2 audio generator (AG) se paida hone wali ek muqarrar frequency ki harmonic sound waves ke do sources hain. Chunke dono speakers ek hi generator se chalte hain, woh ek phase mein vibrate karte hain; aise sources ko coherent sources kehte hain. Hassas cathode ray oscilloscope (CRO) se jura microphone sound waves ka detector hai; CRO input signal ko apni screen par waveform ki shakal mein dikhata hai. Microphone ko baari baari loudspeakers ke saamne mukhtalif nuqton par rakha jata hai (Fig. 7.5b).

blocks.alt: Do loudspeakers S1 aur S2 power amplifier P.A. se jure, jise oopar audio generator A.G. chalata hai. Neeche speakers ke mutawazi ek thos aur ek dashed lakeer; thos par P1, P3, P5 aur dashed par P2, P4. S1 aur S2 se nuqton tak raaste. P1 par microphone CRO se jura hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.5(a): Sound waves ka interference dekhne ka tajrubati intezam (kitab ki Figure 7.5(a) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.alt: Speakers S1 aur S2, P.A. ke zariye A.G. se jure, gol wavefronts bhejte hain: S1 se magenta aur S2 se cyan qaus (arcs); thos qaus compressions aur dashed rarefactions. P1, P3 aur P5 wahan hain jahan ek jaise qaus katte hain; P2 aur P4 wahan jahan thos qaus dashed se katta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.5 (b): Sound waves ka interference (kitab ki Figure 7.5 (b) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Do lagataar thos (ya dashed) qaus ka faasla ek wavelength lambda hai. P1 par S1 se 3.5 lambda aur S2 se 4.5 lambda: farq lambda, is liye awaz oonchi (constructive). P2 par S1 se 3.5 lambda aur S2 se 4 lambda: farq lambda/2, compression rarefaction se milta hai aur awaz khatam (destructive). P3 beech mein hai: farq sifar.

Nuqton P1, P3 aur P5 par compression compression se aur rarefaction rarefaction se milta hai, to superposition ke usool ke mutabiq dono waves ke displacements jama hote hain aur CRO ki screen par bara nateeja displacement dikhta hai (Fig. 7.5c). Fig. 7.5(b) se P1 par waves ka path difference delta S = S2P1 - S1P1 = 4.5 lambda - 3.5 lambda = lambda hai; isi tarah P3 aur P5 par path difference sifar aur -lambda hai, jahan lambda wavelength, yaani kinhi do lagataar thos ya dashed lakeeron ka faasla hai.

blocks.alt: CRO ki screen, darjon wali cross ke sath, jis par bare displacement wali lehar hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.5(c): Constructive interference: CRO ki screen par bara displacement (kitab ki Figure 7.5(c) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Constructive interference
blocks.text: Jab bhi path difference wavelength ka poora mazrab (integral multiple) ho to dono waves jama ho jati hain; is asar ko constructive interference kehte hain. Shart delta S = n lambda hai, jahan n = 0, +/-1, +/-2, +/-3, ...

Nuqton P2 aur P4 par compression rarefaction se milta hai, to superposition ke usool ke mutabiq woh ek doosre ka asar khatam kar dete hain aur nateeja displacement sifar ho jata hai (Fig. 7.5d). P2 par waves ka path difference delta S = S2P2 - S1P2 = 4 lambda - 3.5 lambda = lambda/2 hai; isi tarah P4 par path difference lambda/2 hai.

blocks.alt: CRO ki screen, darjon wali cross ke sath, jis par sirf pari axis par seedhi lakeer hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.5(d): Destructive interference: CRO ki screen par sifar displacement (kitab ki Figure 7.5(d) ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: P1, P3, P5 par microphone ke paas dono lehrein ek sath pahunchti hain, to CRO bari lehar dikhata hai (Figure 7.5(c)). P2, P4 par ek ka compression doosre ke rarefaction se milta hai, to CRO par seedhi lakeer aati hai (Figure 7.5(d)).

blocks.title: Destructive interference
blocks.text: Jin nuqton par do waves ke displacements ek doosre ka asar khatam karein wahan path difference aadhi wavelength ka taaq (odd) mazrab hota hai; is asar ko destructive interference kehte hain. Shart delta S = (2n + 1) lambda/2 hai, jahan n = 0, +/-1, +/-2, +/-3, ...

blocks.title: Example 7.1
blocks.text: 3.0 m ke faasle par do speakers 344 Hz ki mustaqil awaz nikalte hain. Microphone P ko speakers ko milane wali lakeer ke mutawazi aur us se 4.0 m door lakeer par chalaya jata hai. Microphone lakeer ke darmiyan mein aur har speaker ke bilkul saamne ho to sab se buland awaz suni aur CRO par dikhai deti hai. Awaz ki speed nikalein. Hal: S1S2 = 3.0 m, f = 344 Hz, P ki lakeer tak faasla = 4.0 m, v = ?. Sab se buland awaz ke liye path difference 0, +/-lambda, +/-2 lambda, ... hona chahiye; darmiyani nuqte O par path difference sifar hai (S1O = S2O), to wahan constructive interference hai. Constructive interference ke agle nuqte P par path difference lambda hona chahiye: lambda = S2P - S1P. Qaima zawiya tikon S1S2P se S2P = sqrt((S1S2)^2 + (S1P)^2) = sqrt(3^2 + 4^2) = sqrt(9 + 16) = sqrt(25) = 5 m. Lihaza lambda = S2P - S1P = 5 - 4 = 1 m. Chunke v = f lambda, v = 344 x 1 = 344 m s^-1.

blocks.alt: Baen: signal generator do speakers S2 (oopar) aur S1 (neeche) se jura. Un ke beech se ek lakeer 4.0 m door khari lakeer par nuqta O tak; us lakeer par S1 ke saamne microphone P, CRO se jura. Daen: hindsa (geometry), S2 aur S1 3 m door, lakeer 4 m door, O us ke beech, P S1 ke saamne, aur lakeeren S1O, S2O, S1P aur S2P.
blocks.caption: Example 7.1 (PDF page 145): 3.0 m door do speakers aur 4.0 m door lakeer par chalta microphone (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: O beech mein hai, is liye S1O = S2O aur path difference sifar: oonchi awaz. P S1 ke bilkul saamne hai: S1P = 4 m aur right-angled triangle S1 S2 P se S2P = 5 m, to farq 1 m = lambda. Kitab ke chhote khaake mein O beech se hata hua hai aur hal wali S2P lakeer saaf nahi; yahan O ko beech mein aur hal wala triangle S1 S2 P dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Example 7.2
blocks.text: Radio transmitter ke signal ki wavelength 1500 m aur frequency 200 kHz hai. 1000 kHz par chalne wale transmitter ki wavelength kya hai, aur radio waves kis speed se chalti hain? Hal: lambda1 = 1500 m = 1.5 x 10^3 m, f1 = 200 kHz = 2.0 x 10^5 Hz, f2 = 1000 kHz = 1 x 10^6 Hz. Chunke dono signals ki speed ek hai, v = f1 lambda1 = 2.0 x 10^5 x 1500 = 3.0 x 10^8 m s^-1; aur v = f2 lambda2, to lambda2 = v/f2 = 3 x 10^8 m s^-1 / 1 x 10^6 Hz = 3 x 10^2 m.

Safed light se roshan patli sabun ki jhilli (film) interference pattern banati hai (Interesting Fact). Shole mein sodium chloride khalis peeli light deta hai; yeh light monochromatic hai, surkh aur sabz ka mixture nahi (For Your Information).

blocks.prompt: Interference hone ki sharait kya hain, aur coherent waves aur coherent sources kya hain (short questions 7.1, 7.3)? Constructive aur destructive interference mein farq bataiye (short question 7.2).
blocks.explanation: Sources coherent hon, yaani ek hi frequency aur mustaqil phase difference wale (jaise ek generator se chalne wale do speakers); waves ek hi qism ki, taqreeban barabar amplitude ki hon, aur ek hi ilaqe mein milein. Constructive interference wahan hai jahan path difference wavelengths ka poora adad ho, to crest crest se (compression compression se) milta hai aur amplitude barhta hai; destructive wahan jahan aadhi wavelengths ka taaq adad ho, to crest trough se milta hai aur waves khatam ho jati hain.

items: Interference: ek hi frequency ki ek hi simt mein chalti do waves ki superposition. Coherent sources (ek generator, ek phase) aur CRO par microphone: delta S = n lambda par constructive (bara trace), delta S = (2n + 1) lambda/2 par destructive (koi trace nahi).
Example 7.1: S2P = 5 m, lambda = 1 m, v = 344 m s^-1. Example 7.2: v = 3.0 x 10^8 m s^-1, lambda2 = 300 m.
